title: mirror
body:
## mirror

Reflect one additive or subtractive sketch feature across a Body origin XY, XZ or YZ plane, continuing the current tip. It mirrors the selected feature’s material change, not a second disconnected copy of the complete part. The plane is a native origin reference retained in the FCStd.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Mirrored`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |
| `feature` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `plane` | Sketch plane XY (default), XZ or YZ, or the native Body origin mirror plane for mirror. Profile local coordinates follow that plane; explicit frame and onFace attachment provide separate placement choices. | `{"type":"enum","values":["XY","XZ","YZ"]}` | `"YZ"` |
